turns.user: Hi, yeah, I'm calling to find out what your clinic hours are and where you're located. I'm just looking for some basic information right now.
turns.agent:
Thanks for calling. I can book, move or cancel an appointment, or tell you our opening hours — what can I do for you?
I apologize — it looks like our opening hours aren't currently set in the system. Rather than give you incorrect information, I'd like to take a message and have our office team reach out to you directly with our complete hours and any other details you need.

Could I get your name and the best phone number to reach you? That way we can make sure you get accurate information about our location and schedule right away.
You're all set. If anything else comes up, just call us back. Take care — goodbye.
